_comment: DAWG SessionStart hook. Merge the hooks block into <repo>/.claude/settings.json of any repo that uses the dawg MCP server. It fires only when .claude/dawg-project.json exists, so it is safe to add everywhere.

hooks.command: [ -f .claude/dawg-project.json ] && printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"This repo is registered with DAWG. Read .claude/dawg-project.json for its context and project, then call the dawg MCP tool get_project_profile with those values before substantive work. When Sacha corrects you or you learn a non-obvious project fact, offer to save it via add_knowledge scoped to this project. Before ending a working session, offer /retro to capture learnings."}}' || true
